title: Rabbi Yose bar Abaye
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.4.5.2), folio 20a, Rabbi Yochanan says in the name of Rabbi Yose bar Abaye: the tablets sought to fly away, and Moshe held them fast. In [Zevachim 96a (97a in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.97a.7), Rabbi Yochanan speaks in the name of Abba Yose ben Abba; at [25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.25b.9) he speaks in the name of Rabbi Yose bar Abba. Hyman suggests they are all the same person.[^1]

notes.text: Taanit 4:5:2 gives Yose bar Abaye and concerns Moses holding the tablets. Zevachim preserves Abba Yose ben Abba and Rabbi Yose bar Abba in different passages. Hyman supplies the additional Taanit folio 20a and proposes identifying all three names.
